title: Care-Stay Charges Borne in the Closing Year of an Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
For the closing-year tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, the closing-year care-stay charges the resident bore are the nightly charges of Larkspur care stays, every stay type other than the Independent Living Trial Stay, posted in the closing year: where a long-term care insurer paid toward those stays in the closing year they are reduced by the insurer's payments; where no insurer paid but early-departure credits were posted in the closing year they are reduced by those credits; otherwise they count in full; the result never falls below 0.00.

## Records read

The resident's **Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement** ledger in the closing year: payments whose payer is a long-term care insurer, and credits whose reason is early departure.

## Condition table

| Long-term care insurer payment in the closing year | Early-departure credit in the closing year | Charges borne |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Nightly charges less the insurer's payments, never below 0.00 |
| No | Yes | Nightly charges less the early-departure credits, never below 0.00 |
| No | No | Nightly charges in full |

## Hypothetical closing years (care-stay nightly charges 6200.00)

| Insurer payments | Early-departure credits | Charges borne |
|---|---|---|
| 4000.00 | 620.00 | 2200.00 |
| 0.00 | 620.00 | 5580.00 |
| 7000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 6200.00 |
